name: syntax-highlight
description: Syntax-highlights Claude's Bash commands and what they print (Markdown, JSON, diffs, ls -l listings, grep hits, plutil -p...) with your editor's theme and TextMate grammars, and lets Claude show highlighted code on request

editor.title: Editor
editor.description: Whose colour theme and grammars to use. auto = the IDE Claude Code is connected to, else $VISUAL/$EDITOR, else the first editor found on this machine. bundled = the grammars and themes that ship with the mod, reading no editor.

theme.title: Theme override
theme.description: Name of a colour theme (for example 'One Dark Pro' or 'tokyo-night'). Empty = the editor's current theme.

strength.title: Command colour strength
strength.description: How much of the theme's colour shows in Bash commands: 0 = all grey, 1 = full colour. Default 0.55 keeps them dim.

outputStrength.title: Output colour strength
outputStrength.description: Same, for what a Bash command prints. Uncoloured text stays as Claude Code draws it. Default 0.75.

codeStrength.title: Shown-code colour strength
codeStrength.description: Same, for code Claude shows you with the show_code tool.

collapsedLines.title: Collapsed command lines
collapsedLines.description: How many lines of a long command to show before 'ctrl+o to expand'.
